PROPOSE→AUTO requires BOTH 0.2 sign-offs recorded in the ledger header — the standing Round-5 directive (AUTOSCAN.enabled=false, "prices change ONLY when an operator changes them") stands until Berkay explicitly reverses it; the loop may not write one unsolicited rule before that.

0.2 Sign-off sheet (Day-0 deliverable; quotes the SIMULATED numbers, not estimates): (a) Contract choice per cell class. The full standing intent — displayed 97/100 under cheapest AND the 95/10 floor, at every hour, for every shopper — is infeasible on ~95% of cells: measured hour spread (6.85% observed once; 6–9% modeled) exceeds the 5.26% intent window. Choose per class: RANK-priority = ONE_SIDED (floor breached 43–76% of campaign-off time at rank-safe aims; margin give-up 4.9–6.7% at DEEP aim, 3.7–5.4% in the mild-spread world — the sim numbers, NOT the Δ_hour/2 ≈ 3.4% estimate) or FLOOR-priority = STRICT_FLOOR (rank violation-minutes accounted instead). (b) SHALLOW aim prices above the literal 97 target while staying under C1 — needs explicit ok. (c) AUTO = reversal of Round 5. December 2026, Berkay's declared promo-free laboratory, is the sanctioned canary venue.

0.3 Validation gate. The published claim may be tightened below the v2 envelope ONLY after all three: (i) a literal-v3 Monte Carlo — extend zero_error_sim.py to THIS spec verbatim: overlays with precedence, token bucket with queue-age caps, S1 cadences, a per-request 85/15 campaign-lottery world, the p̂ estimator, basis-anchored solve — reproduces results ≤ the envelope; (ii) Day-0/Day-1 calibrations complete (S3 seed, S4 hour survey, campaign-share baseline from stored scan history); (iii) a ≥14-day December-lab canary in MODE_AUTO on the lab station with the C3 ledger live, realized ≤ envelope. Until then, publish exactly the claimed_error below — no basis-point figures.

PART 1 — PLANES, SEGMENTS, ERROR DEFINITION (closes R2)

P1 FMX plane: R(r) = Day1_base × d × chan × (1+r), exact to the cent. chan = product of FMX channel/promotion factors on the rentalcars channel (currently ×0.55 via the 45% promotion, pickups through 1 Nov; = 1.0 for December pickups) — POLLED by S1, never assumed. Verified: GM's own site equals FMX retail to the cent; rentalcars displays FMX retail × M.

P2 API plane and shopper segments. A draw returns either the campaign shape (draw carries 'before'; GM price = 0.88 × basis) or the clean shape; the shape is a PER-REQUEST lottery (measured 12/14 campaign vs 2/14 clean; re-querying never converges). Basis multiplier per draw: M_draw = P_api / (k_draw × R(r_live)), k_draw = 0.88 iff THAT draw carries 'before', else 1.0. M is fleet-uniform to ±0.01% — one GM row pins the fleet; competitor rows are exact and identical across both shapes (verified live: Unirent/Dollar/Thrifty/Hertz to the rappen). Third segment: stale/logged-in sessions at ×~1.05 on basis — measured minority (2 of 11 loads, 2026-08-29); no single FMX percent can serve it and the band simultaneously (PART 9 F2).

P3 Display plane (BINDING): whole francs; ρ seeded HALF-UP from the 8 recorded API/display pairs (114.95→115, 120.95→121, 122.45→122, 126.97→127, 130.62→131, 137.44→137, 139.15→139, 144.28→144 — all consistent), confirmed by S3; equal-franc tie order unknown → ties count as violations until measured. ERROR = at a random shopper moment (hour-integrated over the RC_TIMES rung distribution, campaign lottery applied per-request at measured p̂), the displayed position violates the contract, outside the 15-min grace. Blind minutes are UNMONITORED, never clean.

P4 SOLVE-BASIS RULE (deletes the campaign error class; sim S2: 191 min/event → 0): every solve is anchored on the pre-discount BASIS; never counteract a flagged campaign. Aiming the worst hour-band's BASIS under C1 places BOTH lottery segments under C1 (the campaign rendering is 0.88× lower still). The campaign segment's floor breach during campaigns is exogenous — the −12% badge is rentalcars' own (proven: Dec 15 badge with zero GM promo coverage) — ledgered as CAMPAIGN_FLOOR and excluded from floor accounting per sign-off 0.2(a).

PART 2 — STATE

Per cell: {r_live, Day1/chan fingerprint, M_ewma[3 hour bands], Δ_hour (prior 7%, PROVISIONAL until S4), ladder cache ttl 30 min, contract ∈ {ONE_SIDED, STRICT_FLOOR, HOUR_CONDITIONAL (opt-in), NEAREST_ACHIEVABLE (override)}, tier, b_drift, fail_count_24h, state}. Per station: {p̂ campaign share = EWMA(α=0.1) of the per-draw flag over the probe stream; overlays TURBULENT / BURST / DEGRADED; t_blind}.

Overlay precedence: DEGRADED > BURST > TURBULENT. DEGRADED's write freeze beats BURST triage — never write on blind data; P0 verifies of already-written rules continue. Buffer widenings ADD. TURBULENT's confirmation scoping applies inside both.

Token bucket: refill 2/min, burst 6 (rcGuard allows 120/min — 60× headroom; the cap protects the single deliberate Cloud Run instance). Priorities P0 verify > P1 correct/decide > P2 critical monitor > P3 active > P4 tail. Queue-age cap (closes the R1 starvation hole): any cell whose probe is deferred beyond 2× its cadence has those minutes ledgered UNMONITORED and raises a console chip — starvation is visible and accounted, never silent.

State machine: IDLE → DECIDING → GRACE → VERIFYING → LOCKED → {DRIFT_WATCH | AT_RISK} → CORRECTING → GRACE …; exceptional: STUCK, INFEASIBLE, DATA_ANOMALY, EXTERNAL_EDIT (exit by operator ack or baseline adoption).

PART 3 — SENSORS (all zero relay cost)

S1 FMX poll: every 5 min, hash per governed station: weekly-rule set (%, groups, name, spans) AND base ladders rate1..31 AND channel/promotion percentages AND override expiry dates (closes R6 — a sub-plausibility ±2% ladder/channel edit is now detected within ≤5 min, not 24 h; 30-day advance alerts on the 18-of-30 1/1/2027 override expiries and the 1-Nov promo boundary). r_live is additionally re-read immediately before EVERY solve (D6) and on any implausible draw (V2) — free. External diff → re-baseline r_live/B_eff, station TURBULENT, syncClassify candidate set = ALL horizon generations, cell → EXTERNAL_EDIT: corrections paused; the human edit is adopted as the new baseline or the operator acks a re-take; the loop NEVER overwrites a human edit. On-demand full diff also fires on |M_draw/M_ewma − 1| > 1% on 2 consecutive draws.

S2 Relay heartbeat: /api/watch-status → relayOnline, relays[{name, agoSec}], AND loopLagMaxMs (>1000 = the instance itself froze; counts as blind time). Every firebase deploy is a known 30–60 s 429/blind window: deploys are batched and the window is ledgered.

S3 Display calibration: Day-0 seed ρ = half-up from the 8 recorded pairs (zero probes); monthly recheck against stored scan history; tie order measured opportunistically. Until tie order is confirmed: target P_basis ≤ min(⌊C1⌋ − 0.01, round(C1) − 0.51); ties count as violations.

S4 Hour survey (Day-1; PREREQUISITE for MODE_AUTO — R3): ~50 draws, 2 per hour-band across the RC_TIMES rungs over one day on 3 lab cells. It settles whether the 6.85% spread is a real hour margin or propagation mixing (the 13-Dec browser sweep measured FLAT across 09–18h; the terminal experiment measured +6.85% on 08-Dec — contested). Until it runs, Δ_hour = 7% prior and every hour-dependent figure is labeled PROVISIONAL in the ledger.

S5 Campaign share: p̂ per station from the existing probe stream (no extra draws); regimes CLEAN p̂ < 0.10 / LOTTERY / FULL p̂ > 0.90. Used ONLY for ledger segmentation and CAMPAIGN_FLOOR accounting — never in the solve (P4). v2's M8 gate "flag stable across 2 probes ≥30 min apart" is DELETED: under an 85/15 per-request coin, two probes agree with p ≈ 0.75 forever; it cannot converge and nothing needs it once solves are basis-anchored.

PART 4 — DECIDE

D1 Compile the intent on the display grid, basis plane. "Just under cheapest": allowed franc set S = {n ∈ ℤ : F ≤ n ≤ disp(C1) − 1}, F = max(0.95·C1, C1 − 10). Inverted band (F above the top, C1 ≳ 333): floor-wins point contract per production clamp semantics ("factor = min(targets) clamped up to max(floors)") — aim A = F, predicate [F − q/2, disp(C1) − 1 franc], operator message "floor binds", never "coin flip". Rank-K intents compile identically against comp[10−K].

D2 Feasibility (quantized): W = width(ρ⁻¹(S)); require W ≥ 2 × (σ_cell × P + ρ_resid), σ_cell = max(0.35%, observed cell wobble). Passes C1 = 52.49 (francs {50,51}, W ≈ 1.6 ≥ 0.6 needed) — the volume business is in-domain. Fail → INFEASIBLE naming the ACHIEVABLE contract; operator override → NEAREST_ACHIEVABLE with dual-ledger accounting.

D3 Freshness: ladder cache ≤ 30 min (competitors draw-stable); M ≤ 10 min (≤ 60 min in BURST with widening). Bundle = 2 draws 60–120 s apart (the production write paths already run samples=2 — reuse that machinery), per-draw k → basis M. |M1/M2 − 1| ≤ TOL_GEN = 0.35% → M_hat = mean; else 3rd draw, modal pair; 3-way split → max(M) for ONE_SIDED, median + provisional for STRICT_FLOOR (contract-directional conservatism).

D4 M_ref by contract: ONE_SIDED → max over band EWMAs (unmeasured bands = measured max + 7% prior, PROVISIONAL until S4); STRICT_FLOOR → mean + Δ_hour/2, offered only if Δ_hour ≤ band width; HOUR_CONDITIONAL → canonical-band EWMA, labeled in UI and ledger.

D5 Aim (sim-chosen depths): A = max(F_pre, min(A_depth, T_pre × (1 − b_eff))), where T_pre = upper edge of ρ⁻¹(max S), F_pre = lower edge of ρ⁻¹(min S), b_eff = b_tier + b_drift + overlay widenings. DEEP (default for CRITICAL): A_depth = preimage of the worst band landing at 0.97·C1 — exactly the standing 97 target; sim: 0.02% violation-time, 6.7% margin give-up. SHALLOW (default ACTIVE/volume; requires 0.2(b) ok): A_depth = T_pre, buffer alone sets depth (≈ 0.99·C1 × (1−b)); sim: 0.14% violation-time, 4.9% give-up (3.7% mild world). Low-C1 pre-tie-confirmation: A ≤ disp(C1) − 1.51 CHF.

D6 Read r_live fresh from S1, then solve on BASIS: r_new = A / (Day1 × d × chan × M_ref) − 1 (no k term — P4), rounded to FMX's 2-decimal percent (quantum 0.01 rule-point ≤ 0.046% shelf even at (1+r) = 0.2152, so an exact legal solve always exists). J = (1+r_new)/(1+r_live).

D7 Gates — unsolicited re-aims ONLY, VOID on confirmed FAIL: skip the write if |J − 1| < DEADBAND_J = max(0.30%, q/(2P)) (J-space; sim: 0.30% costs +0.04pp error and saves ~14% of writes vs zero) or the predicted displayed franc is unchanged; REWRITE_MIN = 45 min per cell. A confirmed violation can never be answered with "already in band" — the exact solve is written.

D8 Hygiene (hard, from ops memory): every FMX update restates ALL vehicle groups + groupLabel; duration operator via ruleOpFor (never flip '>=' to '='); price overrides use the verified 31-day base-rate recipe (relative-action 404 trap); one write at a time per station; log {t, r_old→r_new, M_ref, J, mode}; station TURBULENT 30 min; → GRACE.

PART 5 — VERIFY

V1 T_grace = 15 min; P0 draws at +4/+8/+14. If |J − 1| ≥ 1.0% → syncClassify with candidates = all FMX generations seen in the horizon, per-draw k; else position-only with 2 agreeing draws (generations sit 1.3–2.8% apart in J at every rule depth).

V2 All candidates implausible (basis M ∉ [0.985, 1.11]) → immediate S1 re-read BEFORE any transition; FMX unchanged + a 2nd implausible draw → DATA_ANOMALY alert.

V3 CONFIRMED = 2 draws classify NEW (or agree in position mode) AND the display predicate passes on the fresh ladder → LOCKED. Landing-draw M is provisional; the first post-TURB_WIN draw REPLACES it (α = 1), thereafter α = 0.3.

V4 OLD at +14 → extend +19/+24 → STUCK only on actually-OLD-classified draws; missing draws EXTEND timers (DEGRADED semantics — "no data" is never "old rule"); then 10-min probes to +60; the error clock runs from grace end.

V5 Landed but predicate FAILS → CORRECTING with the fresh M; D7 gates void; counts toward fail_count_24h churn control, not monitor-detected failures.

PART 6 — MONITOR

M1 Tiers (sim-fitted): CRITICAL (pickup ≤ 7 d, flagged, or 2+ fails/24 h) 30 min, b = 0.75%; ACTIVE (8–30 d) one-sided 240 min b = 2.0%, strict-floor 180 min b = 1.5% (each covers its own drift bound: 0.45%/h × 4.25 h = 1.91% < 2.0%; × 3.25 h = 1.46% < 1.5%); TAIL (31+ d) 1440 min. Probe hours ROTATE across 3 bands (morning/midday/evening, aligned to the RC_TIMES ring); per-band EWMA; Δ_hour measured from the stream at zero extra cost. Budget at 20/100/200 cells: 20×48 + 100×6 + 200×1 = 1760/day ≈ 1.22/min steady — inside the 2/min bucket with verify headroom (sim capacity check: fleet-wide 30-min rotation supports ~115 cells; tiering is cheaper).

M2 Per probe: per-draw k → basis M_draw; exact ladder refresh; band EWMA update; display predicate + margin recomputed on the FRESH ladder; p̂ update.

M3 Trust: one draw suffices iff not TURBULENT, basis M ∈ [0.985, 1.11], no predicate/campaign flip, |M_draw/M_ewma − 1| ≤ 2%. Competitor rows are draw-exact (measured), so competitor-driven predicate changes ALWAYS act on ONE draw (sim: market-move Monday 13.8% → 3.6%). GM-side surprises need a confirming draw 60–120 s later — except violations > 3σ_cell, which act on one draw. Never write from a single lottery-sized GM-side surprise.

M4 AT_RISK: confirmed FAIL, or a single-draw >3σ / competitor-side violation → CORRECTING; all gates void.

M5 DRIFT_WATCH: margin < 0.75% of T AND 3 consecutive post-gap adverse probes → preemptive in-band correction in EITHER direction (production's one sanctioned upward correction — pulling a price back above the floor); crossing the band TOP always requires a confirmed FAIL.

M6 DEGRADED: t_blind from S2 (including loopLagMaxMs freezes and deploy windows). b_eff += 0.45%/h × t_blind on any cached-data decision; t_blind > 20 min → freeze non-P0 writes + extend verify timers; > 30 min → alert + relay-kick runbook (launchctl kickstart -k "gui/$(id -u)/com.gm.pricing-relay"; tail ~/GMPricingRelay/relay.log; check /api/watch-status). Blind minutes ledgered UNMONITORED; recovery = P1 re-baseline sweep, CRITICAL cells first; DRIFT_WATCH's 3 probes must all be post-gap.

M7 BURST: enter on ≥8 predicate flips/30 min or the SAME competitor moved on ≥5 cells (one draw returns the full exact ladder; adjacent-duration cells share the field → SUSPECT propagation and reprioritization). Inside: 2-draw confirmation waived for violations > 3σ_cell; M reuse ≤ 60 min with buffer widened 0.45%/h × age; corrections ranked by revenue-at-risk (pickup proximity × price × volume); SAMPLED verification — top decile full +4/+8/+14, the rest ONE draw spread over following hours, a failing sample escalates its whole batch; TURBULENT confirmation applies only to surprising draws. Worked 120-cell budget: ~264 draws ≈ 2.2 h at 2/min, top-revenue cells corrected ≤ 30 min. Exit on drained queue + one clean sweep. Ledgered as a NAMED episode, never blended into steady state.

M8 Campaign (rewritten — R2): k is per-draw everywhere; solves are basis-anchored (P4), so campaign flips cannot misprice anything and no stability gate exists. p̂ regime drives ledger segmentation only. CAMPAIGN_FLOOR = campaign rendering below F while basis is in-band → warning class, exogenous; auto-raise NEVER (raising basis to lift the campaign rendering above F would push the clean segment above C1).

PART 7 — CORRECT + LEDGER

C1 Re-run D1–D8 with the trigger draws as the fresh bundle. A confirmed violation ALWAYS produces a write (or a PROPOSE chip in that mode) or an explicit INFEASIBLE / EXTERNAL_EDIT / DEGRADED-freeze alert — never silence.

C2 Escalation: 2 confirmed fails/24 h → CRITICAL + b_drift += 0.5% (cap 2.5%); 3 → operator alert quoting the achievable contract, hold at the conservative edge; 48 h clean → decay toward tier defaults. BURST-episode failures count ONCE per STATION.

C3 Ledger (the audit artifact and the instrument that tightens the claim per 0.3): violation-minutes / monitored-minutes per tier × contract × SEGMENT (campaign / clean / stale-×1.05), hour-integrated; UNMONITORED bucket (blind, starved, deploy windows); named BURST episodes; dual accounting on NEAREST_ACHIEVABLE cells; PROPOSE-mode ack latency; SHADOW-mode counterfactual savings; realized vs claimed side by side.

PART 8 — RISK CLOSURE REGISTER (adversary conditions)

R2 segmentation → CLOSED: per-request lottery modeled (P2/S5), basis-anchored solve covers campaign + clean segments for rank, M8 gate deleted, ledger segmented, claim scope amended. R3 Δ_hour → OPEN BY MEASUREMENT: S4 is an AUTO prerequisite; hour figures PROVISIONAL until it runs. R4 margin/floor sign-off → CLOSED BY PROCESS: 0.2 quotes the sim's 4.9–6.7% give-up, 43–76% floor breach, ~95% joint infeasibility; no contract change without signature. PART 9 — IRREDUCIBLE FLOORS (measured; no single-percent policy removes them)

F1 One displayed franc of placement resolution + unmeasured equal-franc tie order (ties = violations until S3 confirms). F2 The ×1.05 stale-session segment is EXCLUDED from the claim: covering it requires basis ≤ 0.97·C1/1.05 = 0.924·C1, below the 0.95 floor — infeasible inside the standing band; its share (measured minority, 2/11 loads 2026-08-29) is reported per-segment in C3. F4 During campaigns the campaign segment renders 0.88 × basis — below the floor whenever basis is in-band; exogenous (rentalcars' own badge), CAMPAIGN_FLOOR class. F5 Detection latency scales ~linearly with probe interval under the 2/min single-instance ceiling: each adverse step event (≤2/day measured) costs ≤ tier interval + ~3 min confirm/write − 15 min grace. F6 Blind time (relay drops, event-loop freezes, deploys) is UNMONITORED and bounded by M6 — never counted clean.

knobs.name: rollout_mode
knobs.value: SHADOW (ship default) -> PROPOSE (one-click chips) -> AUTO; AUTO requires Berkay's recorded reversal of the Round-5 manual-only directive + the 0.2 contract sign-off; December 2026 lab = 14-day canary
knobs.why: AUTOSCAN.enabled=false is a standing product directive; the loop may not write unsolicited rules without explicit reversal (R5). SHADOW's counterfactual ledger doubles as the R1 production validation.

knobs.name: solve_basis (campaign)
knobs.value: All solves anchored on pre-discount BASIS; k=0.88 used only to invert flagged draws to basis (per-draw, from THAT draw's 'before'); never counteract a flagged campaign; v2's k_write and the 30-min flag-stability gate are DELETED
knobs.why: The campaign is a measured per-REQUEST 85/15 lottery — a stability gate never converges, and black-anchored solves push the clean segment above C1. Basis-under-C1 covers BOTH lottery segments for rank; sim S2: 56-191 min/event -> 0, the whole class disappears.

knobs.name: DEADBAND_J
knobs.value: Skip unsolicited write iff |J-1| < max(0.30%, q/(2P)), J=(1+r_new)/(1+r_live), q=1 CHF; VOID on confirmed FAIL, where the exact solve is always written
knobs.why: J-space fixes the dimensional bug (0.6 rule-points was 2.79% of shelf at deep rules). Sim threshold sweep: 0.30% costs +0.04pp error vs zero deadband and saves ~14% of correction writes; sim S1: deadlock 959 min mean -> 28 min.

knobs.name: generation_classification_cutoff
knobs.value: syncClassify iff |J_expected - 1| >= 1.0%; below, position-only verification with 2 agreeing draws; candidate set = ALL FMX generations seen in the horizon
knobs.why: Generations sit 1.3-2.8% apart in J at every rule depth — classify exactly where it can work, verify by position where it cannot.

knobs.name: aim_depth
knobs.value: DEEP (CRITICAL default): worst hour-band basis lands at 0.97*C1 (= the standing 97 target). SHALLOW (ACTIVE/volume, needs sign-off 0.2b): buffer-only depth ~0.99*C1*(1-b). Low-C1 pre-tie-confirmation: aim <= disp(C1)-1.51 CHF. A = max(F_pre, min(A_depth, T_pre*(1-b_eff)))
knobs.why: Sim-chosen pair: DEEP = 0.02% violation / 6.7% margin give-up; SHALLOW = 0.14% / 4.9% (3.7% mild world). DEEP conveniently equals production's own 97/100 number; SHALLOW deviates from the literal target and therefore needs the operator's ok.

knobs.name: display_calibration (S3)
knobs.value: Day-0 rho seeded HALF-UP from the 8 recorded API/display pairs (zero probes), monthly recheck; tie order unknown -> ties count as violations; pre-confirmation target P_basis <= min(floor(C1)-0.01, round(C1)-0.51)
knobs.why: The contract binds at the shopper's eyes; all 8 recorded pairs are half-up-consistent so calibration starts from data on day 0, and targets stay safe under both plausible roundings until confirmed.

knobs.name: quantized_feasibility_gate
knobs.value: Feasible iff width(rho-inverse of allowed franc set) >= 2*(sigma_cell*P + rho_resid), sigma_cell = max(0.35%, cell wobble); inverted band (C1 >~ 333) = floor-wins point contract at F per production clamp; refusal + override = NEAREST_ACHIEVABLE with dual ledger
knobs.why: Closes the domain hole: C1=52.49 feasible (francs {50,51}, 1.6 >> 0.6 CHF), C1=400 resolves as 'floor binds', and every overridden cell runs a defined aim/buffer/ledger — verified in sim S6 (~0.02% error at +2.9% margin on exactly those cells).

knobs.name: contract_default + hour bands
knobs.value: ONE_SIDED all-hours after sign-off (M_ref = max over 3 band EWMAs; unmeasured bands = measured max + 7% prior, PROVISIONAL); STRICT_FLOOR only where delta_hour <= band width; HOUR_CONDITIONAL = labeled opt-in; probe hours rotate the 3 bands at zero extra cost
knobs.why: ERROR is a random shopper moment and shoppers pick hours; canonical-hour v1 lost 45% of shopper moments while self-reporting ~0 (sim S3). Rotation measures delta_hour from the existing stream; worst-band aiming converts hidden error into a visible margin cost.

knobs.name: hour_survey (S4) — AUTO prerequisite
knobs.value: Day-1: ~50 draws, 2/hour-band across the RC_TIMES rungs on 3 lab cells; until complete, delta_hour = 7% prior and all hour figures are labeled PROVISIONAL
knobs.why: R3: the 6.85% spread is ONE contested measurement (a same-week browser sweep measured FLAT). This single in-budget survey carries the whole hour architecture — it must run before unsolicited writes do.

knobs.name: campaign_share_estimator (S5)
knobs.value: p-hat per station = EWMA(alpha=0.1) of per-draw flag; regimes CLEAN <0.10 / LOTTERY / FULL >0.90; ledger segmentation + CAMPAIGN_FLOOR accounting ONLY — never a solve input
knobs.why: Replaces the unconvergeable M8 stability gate with an estimator that actually converges under a per-request coin flip, and gives the C3 ledger its measured segment weights (R2).

knobs.name: FMX_poll (S1)
knobs.value: 5-min hash per station: weekly rules + rate1..31 base ladders + channel/promotion % + override expiries (30-day advance alerts: 18/30 overrides expire 1/1/2027; promo pickup boundary 1 Nov); r_live re-read before EVERY solve; on-demand full diff on |M_draw/M_ewma-1| > 1% over 2 draws; external diff -> TURBULENT + EXTERNAL_EDIT, human edits never overwritten
knobs.why: FMX reads are the one free sensor. Folding ladders+channel into the 5-min hash closes R6 (sub-plausibility +-2% edits detected in <=5 min, not 24 h of skewed aims); pre-solve r_live reads are the sim-verified ghost-write fix (~240 min blind -> ~12 min).

knobs.name: T_grace + verify_schedule
knobs.value: 15 min; P0 draws +4/+8/+14; extend +19/+24; STUCK only on actually-OLD-classified draws (missing draws extend timers); then 10-min probes to +60; error clock from grace end
knobs.why: Measured propagation 2-10 min; 'no data' and 'old rule' are distinct states, so relay outages can never fake STUCK.

knobs.name: TURB_WIN
knobs.value: 30 min after ANY write (loop or external); confirmation demanded only for SURPRISING draws — expected post-write positions pass on one draw
knobs.why: The draw lottery is write-correlated (30/30 identical in quiet windows, 1.3-2.8% splits near writes); scoping confirmation to surprises keeps burst-day verify cost from doubling.

knobs.name: M freshness
knobs.value: M <= 10 min at DECIDE; ladder cache <= 30 min; BURST exception: M reuse <= 60 min with buffer widened 0.45%/h x age
knobs.why: History cannot predict M (measured); competitors are draw-stable so ladders age well; in a correlated move, ~1% extra discount is cheaper than the probes it replaces.

knobs.name: decide_bundle + split rule
knobs.value: 2 draws 60-120 s apart (reuse the deployed samples=2 write-path machinery), per-draw k; TOL_GEN 0.35% -> mean; 3rd draw on split; 3-way -> max(M) for ONE_SIDED, median+provisional for STRICT_FLOOR
knobs.why: Two agreeing draws defeat the episodic lottery at minimum cost; conservatism is contract-directional (max(M) was anti-conservative toward the floor side).

knobs.name: implied_M_plausibility + fallback
knobs.value: Basis M in [0.985, 1.11]; ALL candidates implausible -> free S1 re-read FIRST; FMX unchanged + 2nd implausible draw -> DATA_ANOMALY
knobs.why: Observed M range [1.0065, 1.0853] plus headroom; gives the fallback a defined branch and routes ghost-writes to the right alarm instead of silent draw-discarding.

knobs.name: tiers + cadence + buffers
knobs.value: CRITICAL 30 min b=0.75% (sim-chosen cadence); ACTIVE one-sided 240 min b=2.0%; ACTIVE strict-floor 180 min b=1.5%; TAIL 1440 min; b_drift +0.5%/confirmed-fail cap 2.5%; DEGRADED adds 0.45%/h x t_blind. Budget 1760 probes/day ~ 1.22/min at 20/100/200 cells
knobs.why: Each buffer covers its own drift bound (1.91% < 2.0%, 1.46% < 1.5% — the v1 arithmetic shortfall is gone); 30-min CRITICAL is the sim's near-zero operating point (0.05% at fleet-wide 30 min) and the tiered budget sits inside the 2/min bucket with verify headroom.

knobs.name: probe_budget + queue-age cap
knobs.value: Token bucket 2/min, burst 6 (vs rcGuard 120/min = 60x headroom); P0 verify > P1 correct > P2 critical > P3 active > P4 tail; deferral beyond 2x a cell's cadence -> minutes ledgered UNMONITORED + console chip
knobs.why: 429 discipline for the deliberately single Cloud Run instance; the queue-age cap closes R1's untested-starvation hole by making starvation visible and honestly accounted, never silent.

knobs.name: single_draw_trust + competitor waiver
knobs.value: Trust 1 draw iff not TURBULENT, M in [0.985,1.11], no flips, |dM| <= 2%; competitor-side predicate changes ALWAYS act on 1 draw (ladders draw-exact); GM-side surprises confirm in 60-120 s except >3*sigma_cell violations
knobs.why: Quiet windows are deterministic and competitors never vary within a draw — sim: this single waiver cuts market-move Monday from 13.8% to 3.6% of the fleet-day.

knobs.name: M_ewma
knobs.value: alpha 0.3 steady; landing draws set only provisional M; first post-TURB_WIN draw REPLACES it (alpha=1)
knobs.why: Landing draws are taken inside the lottery window; re-baselining from the first quiet draw stops a turbulent M from steering the next several corrections.

knobs.name: DRIFT_WATCH preempt
knobs.value: Margin < 0.75% of T AND 3 consecutive post-gap adverse probes -> in-band correction EITHER direction; crossing the band top requires confirmed FAIL
knobs.why: Ramps (<=~0.5%/h measured) caught pre-violation cost ~0 error minutes; bidirectional in-band matches production's one sanctioned upward correction.

knobs.name: REWRITE_MIN
knobs.value: 45 min per cell; VOID on confirmed FAIL and BURST triage; D8 hygiene never waived
knobs.why: Every write opens a fresh propagation lottery, but anti-churn must never outrank fixing a confirmed violation (the v1 deadlock).

knobs.name: BURST mode
knobs.value: Enter on >=8 flips/30 min or same competitor on >=5 cells; SUSPECT propagation via shared adjacent-duration ladders; revenue-at-risk ranking; sampled verify (top decile full, rest 1 draw, failure escalates batch); ~264 draws / 2.2 h for 120 cells; named episode in the ledger
knobs.why: The binding constraint is the correlated day: exploiting exact ladders, ladder sharing and sampled verification cuts 5 h saturation to 2.2 h with top revenue fixed in ~30 min; burst-day error is reported by name, never blended.

knobs.name: DEGRADED + overlay precedence
knobs.value: t_blind from /api/watch-status (relayOnline/agoSec) AND loopLagMaxMs>1000 AND deploy windows; >20 min freeze non-P0 writes + extend timers; >30 min alert + launchctl kickstart runbook; blind minutes UNMONITORED; recovery = P1 re-baseline CRITICAL-first. Precedence DEGRADED > BURST > TURBULENT; widenings additive
knobs.why: The measured system loses its relay 20-40 min exactly on mass-write days, and the instance itself freezes (loopLagMaxMs telemetry exists); claims assuming 100% measurement uptime are false claims. Explicit precedence closes R1's untested overlay-interaction hole: never write on blind data, even mid-burst.

knobs.name: escalation
knobs.value: 2 confirmed fails/24 h -> CRITICAL + b_drift +0.5% (cap 2.5%); 3 -> operator alert quoting the achievable contract; 48 h clean -> decay; BURST failures count ONCE per station
knobs.why: Cells whose volatility exceeds the band need buffer or renegotiation, not more writes; per-station counting stops one market move from mass-escalating 120 cells and blowing the probe budget.

knobs.name: claim_discipline (validation gate)
knobs.value: Published now: v2 envelope (CRITICAL 1.5-3%, ACTIVE 3-6%) + 'mechanism family <= ~0.5%'; basis-point figures forbidden until (i) literal-v3 MC, (ii) S3/S4/S5 calibrations, (iii) 14-day December canary ledger all pass
knobs.why: R1/R7: the sim validated a cousin (P4), not v3 verbatim, and its 0.02-0.14% figures are low-count MC estimates; the C3 ledger — realized vs claimed, per segment — is the instrument that earns any tighter number.

final.claimed_error:
SCOPE: all rates on the DISPLAY plane (whole francs + list order), for the shopper segments the loop can serve — the campaign/black-price segment (Berkay's directive: "asil onemli rakam siyah olan") AND the clean anonymous segment, both covered simultaneously by the basis-anchored solve; the ×1.05 stale-session segment is EXCLUDED by name (irreducible: covering it needs basis ≤ 0.924·C1, below the 0.95 floor) and reported per-segment in the C3 ledger. Hour-integrated over the RC_TIMES rung distribution, 15-min grace excluded, blind/starved/deploy time reported separately as UNMONITORED and never counted clean.

PUBLISHED CLAIM (until the 0.3 validation gate passes — this is the number we stand behind today): ONE_SIDED rank contract ("displayed strictly under C1 at every pickup hour"): CRITICAL tier ~1.5–3% of shopper moments; ACTIVE ~3–6%. STRICT_FLOOR (offered only where Δ_hour ≤ band width): ~2–4% at CRITICAL cadence. HOUR_CONDITIONAL (explicit opt-in): ~1–2.5% of canonical-band moments only, labeled as such. Burst days: ~5–8% violation-minutes on affected cells for that day (vs 15–25% unmitigated), ledgered as a NAMED episode outside steady state. Campaign transitions: ~0 systematic error — the basis-anchored solve deletes the class (sim: 56–191 min/event → 0); residual flips are ordinary step events. MECHANISM-FAMILY POTENTIAL (simulated on the P4 cousin sharing all load-bearing knobs, 40 cells × 60 days, common random worlds): 0.02–0.14% violation-time at 15–60-min cadence, worst cell 0.4% — read as "low single-digit basis points", claimable only after (i) a literal-v3 Monte Carlo reproduces it, (ii) the S3/S4/S5 calibrations complete, and (iii) a ≥14-day December-lab canary ledger confirms it in production.

COSTS STATED HONESTLY (sim-measured, not the Δ_hour/2 estimate): near-zero rank error prices at 4.9–6.7% mean margin give-up (3.7–5.4% in the mild-spread world) at the sim-chosen aims, and rank-safe policies breach the 95/10 floor 43–76% of campaign-off time — because rank AND floor jointly, at every hour, for every shopper, is PROVEN infeasible on ~95% of cells (measured hour spread 6.85%, modeled 6–9%, vs the 5.26% intent window). This is a contract choice on the 0.2 sign-off sheet, not an error rate.

IRREDUCIBLE FLOORS (no policy under these constraints beats them): one displayed franc + unmeasured tie order (ties count against us until S3 confirms); the ×1.05 stale-session exclusion; the joint rank+floor infeasibility; campaign renderings at 0.88×basis below the floor during rentalcars' own campaigns (CAMPAIGN_FLOOR, exogenous); detection latency ~linear in probe interval under the 2/min single-instance ceiling (each adverse step event, ≤2/day measured, costs ≤ tier interval + ~3 min − 15 min grace); blind time bounded by M6 and ledgered UNMONITORED.

ASSUMPTIONS: M dynamics as measured 2026-08-29/30 (fleet-uniform ±0.01%; quiet-window determinism; drift ≤~0.5%/h; steps ≤~3.6%, ≤2/day; basis M ∈ [0.99, 1.09]; hour spread ≤7% prior pending the S4 survey); campaign is a per-request ~85/15 lottery always flagged via 'before'; competitors draw-stable and shape-invariant (verified); propagation ≤15 min for ≥90% of writes (excess surfaces as STUCK from OLD-classified draws and its post-grace time is counted); the 2/min bucket honored; the 5-min S1 poll operational (external-edit exposure ≤5 min); relay outages handled by DEGRADED semantics rather than assumed away; MODE_AUTO not entered before Berkay's Round-5 reversal and contract sign-off. The C3 ledger publishes realized vs claimed per tier × contract × segment continuously — every number above is falsifiable in production within days, by design.
